dogecoin.text:
FOMC got crypto shaking like a bad rug pull  
Whales gobbling BTC while retail cries  
Dogecoin pumps on Elon's wink - classic  
BSC flexing on ETH, Layer2's laughing  
Meme coins? More like clown coins 🫠  
HODL or get rekt, plebs

Bitcoin's mooning past 100K, Ethereum's cooking Layer2,  
while Dogecoin rides Elon's tweets like a cheap meme rocket.  
AI coins think they're smart, but Web3's still a nerd's wet dream.  
Wake up, crypto bros - stop chasing pumps, build something real. 🫠
